test_coverage_notes: The doPeers handler is typically tested via RPC integration tests that exercise the /peers endpoint. Likely test files include rpc-peers-test.cpp, cluster_test.cpp, and overlay_test.cpp. These tests would cover normal and legacy (apiVersion == 1) cases, peer field transformations, and cluster node reporting. However, edge cases such as malformed peer objects, missing fields, or unusual cluster node states (e.g., empty name, zero/invalid fees, default report times) may not be fully covered unless explicitly tested. There is no evidence of unit tests for the validation logic itself; most coverage is likely through end-to-end or integration tests.
